minutes.headline: Committee backed presenting the 3.24% needs-based FY21 budget to the Finance Committee and tabled homework policy 5206.
minutes.summary: The committee heard student council report on a state conference, reviewed three FY21 budget scenarios with school-by-school cuts, and learned the Monty Tech assessment rose while projected new growth fell. It supported the superintendent presenting the original budget to the Finance Committee, tabled the homework policy after teacher union concerns, and discussed coronavirus effects on planned school trips, deferring any decision a week. It then went into executive session for union negotiations.

what_happened.line: A motion to support the superintendent presenting the original needs-based FY21 budget to the Finance Committee was made; the outcome is not audible in the recording.
The committee reviewed three FY21 budget scenarios, with the lowest requiring cuts to the assistant principal and other positions.
The Monty Tech assessment came in over the town manager's estimate, and the town manager lowered projected new growth revenue.
A motion to table homework policy 5206 and return it to the policy subcommittee was made after teacher association concerns; the outcome is not audible.
No decision was made on spring trips affected by coronavirus; the issue returns next week, with a special meeting possible.

why_it_matters: The budget scenarios and the Monty Tech and new growth changes decide which school positions and supplies are kept, and how much the school budget asks of the town budget, mostly taxes.
Families with children booked on spring or summer trips may face cost and refund questions that the committee has not yet settled.
